next.reason: 1985: "[USAGE IS] {BINARY|COMPUTATIONAL|COMP|DISPLAY|INDEX|PACKED-DECIMAL}"; 2023: "BINARY-CHAR ... BIT ... FLOAT-BINARY-32 ... NATIONAL ... PACKED-DECIMAL [ WITH NO SIGN ] ... POINTER". The 2023 format keeps all six 1985 usages but adds alternatives (BIT, NATIONAL, FLOAT-*, POINTER, etc.) and WITH NO SIGN, so programs refused in 1985 are now accepted.
